gloss: end of the century, fin de siecle

definitions.gloss: end of the century, fin de siecle
definitions.explanation: The closing period of a century, especially associated with cultural decadence, anxiety, or upheaval. Often evokes a mood of decline or apocalyptic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has a fin de siecle atmosphere.

examples.japanese: 20{世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}した→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The internet became widespread at the end of the 20th century.

examples.japanese: {世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{退廃的|たいはいてき}な⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧し、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っていた→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: Decadent art was in vogue at the end of the century, and anxiety pervaded society.

notes:
USAGE:
Beyond its literal meaning, {世紀末|せいきまつ} often carries connotations of chaos, decadence, or an apocalyptic mood. In Japanese pop culture, it is strongly associated with the manga/anime Fist of the North Star ({北斗|ほくと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拳|けん}), whose post-apocalyptic setting is described as {世紀末|せいきまつ}.

FORMS:
⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧ (century) + {末|まつ} (end)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: fin de siecle atmosphere
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: apocalyptic, decadent
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: end-of-century thought
